modules.title: OpenAI API 常见功能的请求格式
OpenAI 兼容 API 解决什么问题

items.title: 工具按相近格式发请求
items.text: 工具按照约定的地址和字段发送请求，接入不同的模型服务时，连接方式会更相似。

items.title: 模型服务负责生成结果
items.text: 请求送到模型服务后，由它负责处理内容并生成回答。不同服务使用的模型和处理方式可能不同。

items.title: 每项能力都要单独确认
items.text: 比如，一个只支持文本的模型，即使接口能接收图片字段，也可能无法识别图片。工具调用、流式返回等功能也要分别测试。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: OpenAI 兼容 API 是通信协议层的约定，不是 OpenAI GPT 模型本身。它统一的是通信格式，不等于底层模型拥有 OpenAI 模型的工具调用、多模态或流式能力。

lessonPractice.title: 接口格式兼容，但模型提示不支持工具调用，哪项判断正确？

options.label: 通信格式兼容不代表底层模型具备工具调用能力
options.feedback: 对。兼容 API 解决请求怎样包装，工具调用还取决于底层模型的能力。

options.label: 只要接口兼容，底层模型就应当拥有 GPT 的全部能力
options.feedback: 接口协议和模型能力是不同层次；兼容声明不能保证工具调用、多模态或流式表现相同。

options.label: 强行打开一个配置项就能补出模型没有的工具调用能力
options.feedback: 配置只能请求某项能力，不能替底层模型增加理解工具和生成结构化参数的能力。

en.title: The endpoint is compatible, but the model says it does not support tool calls. Which judgment is correct?

options.label: Protocol compatibility does not mean the underlying model supports tool calls
options.feedback: Correct. A compatible API standardizes request packaging; tool calls still depend on the model.

options.label: A compatible endpoint must provide every capability of a GPT model
options.feedback: Protocol and model capability are different layers; compatibility does not guarantee identical tool, multimodal, or streaming behavior.

options.label: A configuration flag can add tool-calling capability that the model does not have
options.feedback: A setting can request a capability, but it cannot give the model the ability to understand tools and emit structured arguments.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先查当前工具和模型服务各自支持的 OpenAI 兼容端点，再用无敏感内容的请求分别测试普通对话和工具调用。记录实际请求地址、状态码和缺失能力，不要打印真实 Key。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check which OpenAI-compatible endpoints the tool and model service both support, then use non-sensitive requests to test ordinary chat and tool calling separately. Record the actual URL, status code, and missing capabilities without printing the real key.

learning.assumes: You know that APIs agree on a shape for requests and responses.
learning.outcome: You can separate protocol compatibility from model capability and test the features your tool actually needs.

modules.title: What problem does an OpenAI-compatible API solve?

items.title: The tool sends a familiar request
items.text: The tool sends a request with familiar paths and fields, so connecting to different model services looks similar.

items.title: The model service generates the result
items.text: The model service receives the request, processes it, and generates the answer. Different services may use different models and processing rules.

items.title: Check each capability separately
items.text: For example, a text-only model may accept an image field without being able to understand the image. Tool calls and streaming also need separate tests.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An OpenAI-compatible API is a communication convention, not an OpenAI GPT model. It standardizes communication format; it does not mean the underlying model has OpenAI model capabilities such as tool calling, multimodal input, or streaming.

distinctions.label: Base URL
distinctions.text: A {c:base-url} is the network root prefix of a server; an {c:openai-compatible-api} specifies the protocol schema and message format used over that connection.
